name: Toast
oneLiner: Restaurant-specific POS and management platform (NYSE: TOST) covering point of sale, online ordering, kitchen display, payroll and team management, marketing, loyalty and multi-location controls.
bestFor: Restaurants from single locations to multi-unit and franchise groups that want POS, ordering, payroll and guest marketing from one vendor.

updates.text: Spring 2026 release launched Toast IQ Grow, a premium package with an AI Marketing Agent, a marketing success manager and Marketing Essentials, and relaunched the Toast Local guest app with loyalty built in.
Q2 2026 results: about 9,500 net new locations in the quarter, roughly 180,000 live locations and $2.4B ARR as of June 30, 2026.
Announced its 2026-2027 independent restaurant Customer Advisory Board.

features: POS on counter terminals, kiosks and Toast Go handhelds
Online ordering, delivery integrations and the Toast Local guest app
Central menu and pricing management across locations
Payroll, team management and scheduling (Sling by Toast)
Loyalty, gift cards and email/SMS marketing
Toast IQ AI features, including an AI marketing agent in Toast IQ Grow

pricing.text: Not re-confirmed in this research; Toast quotes plans through sales (a free Starter Kit and paid plans have been advertised on toasttab.com). Check the current pricing page before publishing a figure.

notes: Dropped from current review: '127,000 restaurant locations' (outdated; Toast reported ~180,000 live locations at June 30, 2026), '24.46% market share' (unsourced), '$69/month per location' (not verified this round).
